$description: Samra Pay — Midnight Gold design tokens (DTCG). Dark is the canonical source (the app renders dark-only); light is a warm-ivory derivation. Edit values here only — do not hand-edit src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.tsx. The build script (scripts/build-tokens.mjs) converts hex to `H S% L%` channels for the web theme and keeps hex for mobile.

light.$description: Warm-ivory derived light mode. The Samra Pay app renders dark-only; this mode is provided for design-system consumers who need a light context.

foreground.$description: Very dark warm black body text.

primary.$description: 22-karat Midnight Gold — the Samra Pay brand color. Drives buttons, links, focus rings, and emphasis across both modes.

primaryForeground.$description: Near-black on gold — passes WCAG AA at ~8:1.

accent.$description: Light gold wash — used for selected/active states in the app.

coffee.$description: Buna — roasted coffee brown. Semantic role: savings / accounts category, secondary chart series.

berbere.$description: Berbere terracotta. Semantic role: outflows, debits, spice/warm emphasis. Not a danger color — destructive stays separate.

eucalyptus.$description: Eucalyptus green. Semantic role: completed transfers, positive deltas, ETB series.

injera.$description: Injera cream. Semantic role: soft category wash / neutral surfaces behind cultural content.

dark.$description: Canonical dark mode — extracted directly from artifacts/samra-pay/src/index.css :root values.

primary.$description: 22-karat Midnight Gold (hsl 46 65% 52%). The single brand color across both modes.

accent.$description: Dark gold wash (hsl 46 65% 15%) — selected state background.

coffee.$description: Buna — roasted coffee brown, lifted for dark surfaces (AA vs. its foreground).

berbere.$description: Berbere terracotta, lifted for dark surfaces (AA vs. its foreground). Outflows / debits — not the danger color.

eucalyptus.$description: Eucalyptus green, lifted for dark surfaces. Completed transfers / positive deltas.

injera.$description: Injera cream inverted to a warm dark wash for cultural-content surfaces.

sans.$description: Primary UI and body typeface. Used for all interface copy, labels, and body text. Weights 300–700 are in regular use; 300 (light) appears frequently in hero and display contexts.

serif.$description: Display and editorial typeface. Used for hero headings, section titles, exchange-rate figures, and italic gold emphasis. Weights 400–700, with italic variants.

ethiopic.$description: Ge'ez-script typeface for Amharic copy (አማርኛ). Pairs with EB Garamond at display sizes and Outfit in UI. Use for any Amharic text; falls back gracefully for Latin glyphs.

base.$description: Base corner radius (12 px). sm=8px, md=10px, lg=12px, xl=16px. Cards and panels use rounded-xl (16px); inputs and badges use rounded-md (10px).
Base spacing step (4 px). Dashboard cards use p-6 (24px); page gutters use p-4/p-8; hero sections use pt-32 pb-24.

textStyle.$description: Semantic typography roles. Each role specifies fontFamily (reference token path), fontSize (rem), fontWeight (string), lineHeight (number ratio), and letterSpacing (em or 0). These are portable across web and native — use the fontFamily key to look up the actual font stack from typography.fontFamily.

xl.$description: Largest hero display — EB Garamond, editorial impact at 72px.

lg.$description: Large hero display — EB Garamond at 60px.

md.$description: Mid hero display — EB Garamond at 48px.

xl.$description: Section heading XL — Outfit SemiBold at 36px.

lg.$description: Section heading LG — Outfit SemiBold at 30px.

md.$description: Section heading MD — Outfit SemiBold at 24px.

sm.$description: Section heading SM — Outfit SemiBold at 20px.

lg.$description: Large body text — Outfit Regular at 18px. Use for lead paragraphs.

md.$description: Default body text — Outfit Regular at 16px.

sm.$description: Small body text — Outfit Regular at 14px. Secondary descriptions.

lg.$description: Large label — Outfit Medium at 14px. Form labels, nav items.

md.$description: Medium label — Outfit Medium at 13px. Compact form labels.

sm.$description: Small label — Outfit Medium at 12px. Badges, tags.

caption.$description: Caption text — Outfit Regular at 11px. Timestamps, footnotes, disclaimers.

balance.$description: Large balance display — EB Garamond Medium at 48px. Used for account balance hero.

amount.$description: Transaction amount — Outfit SemiBold at 24px. Used in transaction rows and confirmations.

rate.$description: Exchange rate display — EB Garamond Regular at 30px. Used in quote panels.

display.$description: Amharic display text — Noto Serif Ethiopic Regular at 48px. Heroes and section covers with Amharic copy.

heading.$description: Amharic heading — Noto Serif Ethiopic Regular at 24px.

body.$description: Amharic body text — Noto Serif Ethiopic Regular at 16px. Line height 1.7 to accommodate Ge'ez script complexity.

label.$description: Amharic label — Noto Serif Ethiopic Regular at 14px.

interaction.$description: Interaction dimension tokens. Touch targets follow platform minimums (iOS HIG: 44pt, Android Material: 48dp). Safe-area insets are intentionally excluded — they MUST come from platform APIs: useSafeAreaInsets() on React Native and env(safe-area-inset-*) on web. Never use fixed values for safe areas.

ios.$description: iOS minimum touch target in points (per Apple HIG). Components must not be smaller than this in any dimension.

android.$description: Android minimum touch target in dp (per Material Design). Components must not be smaller than this in any dimension.

sm.$description: Small control height in px — compact form fields, inline selects.

md.$description: Medium control height in px — default form fields, buttons.

lg.$description: Large control height in px — prominent CTAs, mobile-first inputs.

xs.$description: Extra small icon — decorative indicators, status dots.

sm.$description: Small icon — inline with label text.

md.$description: Medium icon — default icon in buttons and nav.

lg.$description: Large icon — standalone icons, icon buttons.

xl.$description: Extra large icon — empty states, feature illustrations.

focusRingWidth.$description: Focus ring width in px. Must be visible in both light and dark modes using the ring token color.

pressedOpacity.$description: Opacity applied to interactive elements in their pressed state. Provides clear visual feedback without hiding content.

disabledOpacity.$description: Opacity applied to disabled controls. 0.38 is the Material Design standard for disabled state — meaningful visual reduction without making content illegible.

loadingOpacity.$description: Opacity applied to content while in a loading state, when showing a spinner over existing content.

layout.$description: Layout and spacing tokens for consistent page structure across web and mobile surfaces.

mobile.$description: Horizontal page margin on mobile in px. Consistent with standard mobile UX conventions.

tablet.$description: Horizontal page margin on tablet in px.

desktop.$description: Horizontal page margin on desktop in px.

sm.$description: Small vertical gap between sections in px.

md.$description: Medium vertical gap between sections in px.

lg.$description: Large vertical gap between sections in px.

sm.$description: Small card internal padding in px.

md.$description: Medium card internal padding in px — default.

lg.$description: Large card internal padding in px — prominent cards.

formSpacing.$description: Vertical gap between form fields in px. Applies between Label+Input groups.

sm.$description: Extra-small inline gap in px — between icon and label.

md.$description: Small inline gap in px — between badge and text.

lg.$description: Medium inline gap in px — between grouped controls.

compact.$description: Multiplier applied against standard spacings for compact density mode. Use for data-heavy interfaces.

spacious.$description: Multiplier applied for spacious density mode. Use for onboarding, marketing, and reading-focused surfaces.

max.$description: Maximum content width in px for mobile screens. Keep single-column content within this for readability.

sm.$description: Small content container width in px.

md.$description: Medium content container width in px.

lg.$description: Large content container width in px.

xl.$description: Extra-large content container width in px.

max.$description: Maximum content container width in px — wide displays.

sm.$description: Small breakpoint in px. Tailwind: sm.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint in px. Tailwind: md.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint in px. Tailwind: lg.

xl.$description: Extra-large breakpoint in px. Tailwind: xl.

sm.$description: Small modal width in px — confirmations, alerts.

md.$description: Medium modal width in px — standard forms.

lg.$description: Large modal width in px — complex forms, detail views.

mobile.$description: Bottom/side sheet width on mobile — always full width.
App header height in px on mobile.

desktop.$description: App header height in px on desktop.

bottomNavHeight.$description: Bottom navigation bar height in px on mobile. Add safe area inset from platform API.

motion.$description: Motion tokens for animations and transitions. These are portable reference values. Web uses CSS custom properties from theme-template.css; native code references these values directly. All durations assume prefers-reduced-motion is respected — collapse to 0ms when reduced motion is requested.

standard.$description: Default transition — most UI state changes.

gentle.$description: Deliberate entrance — modals, panels, content reveals.

entrance.$description: Entrance spring — quick start, gentle settle.

emphasized.$description: Emphasized spring — slight overshoot for expressive moments.

exit.$description: Exit ease — quick departure, no overshoot.

elevation.$description: Elevation reference values for native shadow computation. Web consumes elevation from theme-template.css CSS variables (shadow-e1…e5, shadow-gold-sm|md|lg). Native code uses these structured definitions to construct platform shadows. Each entry describes a two-layer shadow system for depth realism.

e1.$description: Hairline lift — the lightest elevation. Use for subtle separation of adjacent surfaces.

e2.$description: Card elevation — standard for content cards and list panels.

e3.$description: Raised card / popover elevation — popovers, tooltips, floating elements.

e4.$description: Overlay elevation — drawers, bottom sheets, overlaid content panels.

e5.$description: Modal elevation — full-screen modals and critical dialogs.

goldSm.$description: Small gold ambient glow — subtle brand emphasis around gold UI elements.

goldMd.$description: Medium gold ambient glow — primary buttons, focused inputs.

goldLg.$description: Large gold ambient glow — hero elements, featured card faces.

status.$description: Financial transaction status tokens. Each status entry has foreground, background, border, iconName (descriptive — not library-specific), textRequired (always true — never use color alone), and accessibilityNote. WCAG AA requires color never be the sole means of conveying information — always pair status color with a text label and/or icon.

$value.accessibilityNote: Provide aria-label or visible text describing the neutral state. Do not rely on gray color alone.
Use role='status' and aria-live='polite' for informational updates. Always accompany with visible text label.

information.$description: NEW hex — #60a5fa (blue-400) not in existing palette. See docs/open-decisions.md.

$value.accessibilityNote: Use role='alert' for warnings that require immediate attention. Text must describe the warning — do not rely on amber/orange color alone.

warning.$description: Foreground references dark berbere palette (#cf6644). Background is a darkened berbere wash.

$value.accessibilityNote: Announce 'Transfer submitted — awaiting processing' to screen readers via aria-live='polite'. Submission does not guarantee completion.

submitted.$description: Uses accentForeground gold (#e9d99a) on dark gold wash. Muted to distinguish from processing.

$value.accessibilityNote: Use aria-live='polite' and aria-busy='true' on the containing region. Announce 'Processing your transfer' — never say 'almost done' without certainty.

processing.$description: Uses primary gold (#d4af37) foreground on dark gold wash background.

$value.accessibilityNote: Announce completion with aria-live='assertive' only for the first status change to completed. Use visible text 'Transfer complete' or equivalent. Never show a checkmark without text.

completed.$description: Uses dark eucalyptus green (#6b9a78) — completed transfers / positive deltas.

$value.accessibilityNote: Use role='alert' and aria-live='assertive'. Always explain what failed and provide a path forward (retry, contact support). Never show only a red X icon.

failed.$description: NEW hex — #f87171 (red-400) lifted for dark surfaces. More legible than dark-mode destructive (#803636). See docs/open-decisions.md.

$value.accessibilityNote: Use role='alert'. Display visible text 'Transfer cancelled'. Include the cancellation reason if available. Screen readers must not convey cancellation by color alone.

cancelled.$description: NEW hex — #ef4444 (red-500). Distinct from failed to allow differentiation in text. See docs/open-decisions.md.

$value.accessibilityNote: Announce 'Refund pending — expected within X business days'. Use aria-live='polite'. Consumer must provide the estimated timeframe string.

refundPending.$description: Uses dark berbere orange (#cf6644) — refund in queue, not yet processed.

$value.accessibilityNote: Announce 'Refund completed'. Use aria-live='polite'. Show refunded amount prominently alongside status label.

refunded.$description: Uses dark coffee brown (#ab7549) — refund completed, amount returned.

$value.accessibilityNote: Announce 'Transaction reversed'. Use aria-live='polite'. Always display the reversal reference number alongside status text.

reversed.$description: Uses dark coffee brown (#ab7549) — transaction reversed, money returned to sender.

$value.accessibilityNote: Announce 'Rate data may be outdated' with aria-live='polite'. Always provide a refresh action. Never hide stale data — show it with a clear warning label.

stale.$description: Uses dark berbere orange (#cf6644) — data is stale, refresh needed.

$value.accessibilityNote: Announce 'No internet connection' with aria-live='assertive' on first detection. Use role='status' for persistent offline banners. Always display 'You are offline' text — never rely solely on a wifi-off icon.

offline.$description: Uses mutedForeground gray (#adadad) — offline/no connectivity state.

$value.accessibilityNote: Use aria-live='polite'. Always name the unavailable service (e.g., 'Transfer service is temporarily unavailable'). Provide support contact or retry option.

unavailable.$description: Uses mutedForeground gray (#adadad) — service or feature temporarily unavailable.
